rejection_reason.detail: The inherited WALE/Vreman velocity-gradient helper used torch.roll on every dimension. That imposes a periodic connection between opposite faces of each independently allocated AMR level, creating nonphysical shear at open far-field and refinement-block boundaries.
rejection_reason.numerical_health_at_stop: Both candidates were finite and limiter-free, but numerical health cannot make a spatially invalid SGS operator physically admissible.

corrective_action.implementation: Replace periodic roll differences with centered second-order interior differences and second-order one-sided physical-edge differences, including defined one- and two-cell behavior.

conclusion: These partial trajectories are implementation-rejection evidence only and must never be used in force, stability, or SGS sensitivity claims.
